title: USER_CLOCK_IN event
description: Emitted when the user clicks Clock In. See ADR-0003 §3.

geo_optout.description: Reserved: acknowledges the user has been shown the geolocation-off notice. Geolocation is not collected in MVP; this field is only carried for schema-shape stability once geo becomes an opt-in feature.

start_source.description: Clocked in from the computer's sign-in time (ADR-0018 §4). The session starts at started_at when it is no later than client_ts and at most 12 hours before it.

started_at.description: The Windows / macOS sign-in time offered to the person (ADR-0018 §4).
